[RDSC.6.5.3] `window_ns` is the cooldown window in
nanoseconds. The rate gate in the rule's fire guard ([RLOW.4.6.1]) holds a
firing back while less than `window_ns` has passed since the gate last let it fire
for the same activation key ([RLOW.4.6.2.2]). Each key has its own window
([RLOW.4.6.2.3]).
